Three different proteins are shown to illustrate the different shapes of proteins. Enzymes 
which have 5 different colors of amino acid strands to form the linear shape of this protein. 
A hormone which is more simple in structure with 3 different colors of amino acid strands 
joining together to form this globular protein and antibodies which is the most complex with 
4 different colors of amino acid strands coming together to form a 3-dimensional y-shaped 
structure.
